title: ESPHome Device Log Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=esphome:device
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by entity_id
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when ESPHome device log data has stopped arriving for a given entity.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per entity and alert when the feed is older than 1 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It will show when one part of your ESPHome device log feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
